metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM 2D Milling Per-Op Tab Deep Pass — Strategy / Output / Holder / Ramp Coverage + Drill Family
metadata.description: Deep-pass extension to 2d-operations.json (MS0/U-CAM21). Closes the input-exhaust gap by adding 4 previously-uncatalogued tabs (Strategy, Output/Manual-NC, Holder, Ramp) to the 11 existing 2D milling ops, AND introduces 4 net-new drill-family ops (DRILL_2D, TAP_2D, REAM_2D, COUNTERBORE_2D) that were missing entirely. Together brings Fusion 360 2D milling to 100% input-field coverage per the L2-CAMX-EXHAUST mandate.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — 2D Milling reference (Adaptive/Pocket/Contour/Face/Slot/Trace/Engrave/Bore/Circular/Thread/Chamfer) + Drilling reference (12 cycle codes: drill / counterbore / chip-break / deep-drill / gun-drill / tap / right-tap / left-tap / ream / fine-bore / back-bore / circular-pocket) + post.cps Manual NC reference + Holder Collision Check documentation + Ramp Entry Strategy documentation

commonTabs.description: New tabs added by the deep pass on top of the existing 5-tab base (Tool/Geometry/Heights/Passes/Linking). Drill-family ops use the full 8-tab structure including a Cycle tab.

ADAPTIVE_2D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to 2D_ADAPTIVE_CLEARING — adds Strategy (engagement / direction / order), Ramp (helical entry / lead-in detail), Holder (collision checks + safety distance), Output (pre/post events + manual NC).

parameters.name: Optimal Load
parameters.description: Target radial engagement (woc) for adaptive load control

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: Smooth toolpath corners to reduce dynamic load

parameters.name: Ramp Clearance Height
parameters.description: Height above stock for ramp staging

parameters.name: Pre-Drill Tip Diameter
parameters.description: Pre-drilled hole tip diameter (for plunge ramp)

parameters.name: Holder Clearance
parameters.description: Min clearance from holder to part/stock

parameters.name: Tool Change Position
parameters.description: Named position for tool changes (G28 / home / pallet-clear)

parameters.name: Coolant Pre-Spin
parameters.description: Dwell after spindle on / coolant on

parameters.name: Probe Macro
parameters.description: Probe macro name (links to MS1-01 probing module)

parameters.name: Avoidance Geometry
parameters.description: Bodies/faces to avoid during connection moves

POCKET_2D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to 2D_POCKET — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for offset-pocket roughing.

parameters.name: Finishing Pass
parameters.description: Add wall-finish pass at the end

parameters.name: Stay Down Distance
parameters.description: Max horizontal distance allowed without retract

CONTOUR_2D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to 2D_CONTOUR — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for profile finishing with multi-pass rough+finish chains.

CHAMFER_2D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to 2D_CHAMFER — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for chamfer/deburr edge ops.

parameters.name: Chamfer Tip Offset
parameters.description: Distance below chamfer tip for tool tip

FACE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to FACE — Strategy (raster pattern + back-and-forth detail) / Ramp / Holder / Output.

SLOT_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to SLOT — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output.

TRACE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to TRACE — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for sketch-driven engraving / scribing / chamfer-trace.

ENGRAVE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to ENGRAVE — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for V-bit engraving with adaptive depth-by-width.

BORE_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to BORE — Strategy / Cycle (G85/G86/G89/G76 fine bore / G87 back bore) / Holder / Output.

parameters.name: Output Cycle
parameters.description: Emit canned-cycle G-code instead of long-form

parameters.name: Group by Tool
parameters.description: Group all bore-cycle holes for one tool

CIRCULAR_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to CIRCULAR — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output for circular pocket / circular profile.

parameters.name: Output Subroutines
parameters.description: Emit pattern of holes as subroutine

THREAD_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to THREAD — Strategy / Cycle (G84 rigid tap / G74 reverse / thread-mill helical) / Holder / Output.

parameters.name: Number of Threads
parameters.description: Helical pass count for thread mill

parameters.name: Reverse Spindle Speed Multiplier
parameters.description: Retract RPM as multiple of cut RPM

DRILL_2D.description: Net-new 2D drilling op covering all 12 Fanuc/Siemens canned-cycle codes — drill / counterbore / chip-break / deep-drill / gun-drill plus left-tap / right-tap / ream / fine-bore / back-bore / circular-pocket. Selection by Cycle Type drives canned-cycle output and parameter visibility.

parameters.name: Diameter Filter
parameters.description: Only holes within tolerance of nominal

parameters.name: Drill Tip Through
parameters.description: Drill until tool tip exits stock bottom

parameters.name: Tool Tip Compensation
parameters.description: Adjust depth for drill tip angle

parameters.name: Output Cycle
parameters.description: Emit canned cycle vs long-form moves

parameters.name: Output Comments per Hole
parameters.description: Inject hole index comment per drill

TAP_2D.description: Net-new 2D tapping op specialized from DRILL_2D — covers rigid (G84/G84.2/G84.3) and floating tap with tension/compression heads. Auto-binds Pitch + RPM + Feed via F = N × P (mm/min) for rigid sync.

REAM_2D.description: Net-new 2D reaming op — G85 reaming canned cycle with optional peck-ream variant for deep blind holes. Specifies pre-drilled diameter, allowance, and finish-feed-per-rev for H7 / H8 finished bore quality.

parameters.name: Reverse Out at Feedrate
parameters.description: Retract at feed (vs rapid) — preserves bore finish

COUNTERBORE_2D.description: Net-new 2D counterboring op — G82 with dwell at bottom for clean shoulder, plus countersink subset (chamfer-bit angle-driven counterbore depth). Used for socket-head / fillister cap-screw recesses.

parameters.name: Use Bit Angle for Countersink
parameters.description: Compute depth from chamfer-bit angle + diameter
